tools.name: check_tax
tools.description: Check inputs to calculate a tax return for a given jurisdiction. The 'input' argument must conform to the JSON schema returned by the tax_namespace_schema tool. Returns 'Success' on success, or validation errors if the input is invalid. If some inputs trigger a PARTIAL DISQUALIFICATION, the check still succeeds but includes disqualification details — proceed to calculate_tax to get the document and estimate the impact. Use this tool to validate inputs before calculating the tax return.

params.name: input
params.description: Tax input data conforming to the schema from the tax_namespace_schema tool.

params.name: tax_year
params.description: Tax year to calculate for (e.g., "TY25"). Defaults to the current tax year.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: State jurisdiction to validate (e.g., "pa"), in addition to federal.Use the tax_jurisdictions tool to list available jurisdictions.

tools.name: calculate_tax

Returns computed tax return document on success, or validation errors if the input is invalid. If some inputs trigger a PARTIAL DISQUALIFICATION, the document is still returned for the supported fields; review the disqualification details and estimate the impact of the unsupported fields on the taxpayer's tax owed or refund due. tools.name: tax_jurisdictions

params.name: tax_year

tools.name: tax_namespace_schema
tools.description: Get the TCB input schema for a single namespace (e.g. "irs1040", "irs1040_schedulec", "ca_form540"). Returns the properties and types for that namespace. HOW TO READ THE SCHEMA: (1) Each field references a type like tcb_string_null, tcb_integer_null, or tcb_boolean_null. All values must be wrapped as {"value": <val>}. params.name: format
params.description: Output format. "summary" (default) returns a compact list of fields with type, enum, required, and description. "full" returns the raw JSON Schema.

params.name: tax_year
params.description: Tax year (e.g. "TY25"). Defaults to the current tax year.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace ID (e.g. "irs1040", "irs1040_schedulec", "ca_form540").

tools.name: tax_namespaces
tools.description: List all available input namespaces for a given jurisdiction. Use the returned names with the tax_namespace_schema tool to get the schema for a specific namespace. Requires a jurisdiction (e.g. "us" for federal, "ca" for California). Use the tax_jurisdictions tool first to discover available jurisdictions. params.name: tax_year
params.description: Tax year (e.g. "TY25"). Defaults to the current tax year.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: Jurisdiction to list namespaces for (e.g. "us", "ca", "az").

tools.name: tax_simple_return
tools.description: Call this FIRST when beginning any tax return. Returns the curated namespace list, top-level structure guide, example input, and step-by-step filing workflow. By default returns a simple scenario (single or MFJ filer, W-2 income only, standard deduction, no dependents). Pass scenario="with_dependents" for returns that include dependents, child care (Form 2441), and education credits (Form 8863). params.name: scenario
params.description: Return scenario. "simple" (default): single/MFJ, W-2 only, no dependents. "with_dependents": includes dependents, Form 2441 (child care), and Form 8863 (education credits).

params.name: tax_year
params.description: Tax year (e.g. "TY25"). Defaults to the current tax year.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: State jurisdiction code (e.g. "ca", "ny"). Omit for federal-only.

tools.name: generate_tax_pdf_tool
tools.description: Start async PDF generation for a tax return. The 'input' argument must conform to the JSON schema returned by the tax_namespace_schema tool. params.name: input
params.description: Tax input data conforming to the schema from the tax_namespace_schema tool.

params.name: tax_year
params.description: Tax year to generate for (e.g., "TY25"). Defaults to the current tax year.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: Jurisdiction to include in the PDF (e.g., "pa"), in addition to the federal.Use the tax_jurisdictions tool to list available jurisdictions.

tools.name: get_tax_pdf_tool
tools.description: Check status of a PDF generation job. Returns the status and a download URL when completed, only use this tool after generating the tax PDF with the generate_tax_pdf tool and it successfully returns a job ID.

params.name: id
params.description: The PDF result UUID returned by generate_tax_pdf.
